scope: Eight H10080GB GPUs on two nodes; four Attention sources/four FFN workers; communication+one BF16 H2048/I4096/E128/K8 MoE layer. Resident inputs; no Attention compute/full serving claim.
timing: All startup/compile/capture/first replay/reference checks excluded. Runtime staging/replay/output collection/source-window drain included; final buffer close/lifetime drain excluded. Every tail is retained. No per-request CPU collective barrier.
latency: GPU interval from first source staging to its output copy; request_pipeline includes deliberate queued work with two originals in flight. Host completion is an observed upper bound. Neither is end-to-end serving response.
memory: PyTorch active/peak increments are relative to each rank's own pre-setup baseline, excluding resident inputs/outputs/weights. FFN values are per GPU. Native registered capacity is separately summed across all eight GPUs; these are not total VRAM.
interpretation: Historical large-batch C2 throughput regression did not reproduce on the fresh unchanged transport allocation. Positive fresh results therefore cannot be attributed to A/B changes. B independently removes unused RMA CPU progress threads. New full-request policies preserve original GEMM sizes and trade extra memory/queueing for inter-request overlap.

primary_comparison.baseline: serialized afdEP whole_graph within the same E workload/repeat; no Masked DeepEP rerun
primary_comparison.uncertainty: Observed repeat ranges, not confidence intervals. Per-request tails are correlated observations and do not count independent stall events. C/D/E are separate cohorts, not pooled trials.

data.scope: One-second live CPU samples on the same allocation; both have two communication slots. This validates unused RMA-thread removal, not causality of prior GPU stalls.

backend_ABBA_controls.scope: Four sequential C-source backend-only blocks, type2/type3/type3/type2; two within-block repeats of whole/request at132 DeepGEMM SMs. Each block remains a separate cohort; type2 also has long tails. This is not evidence that switching the backend fixes stalls.

direct_forwarding_control.scope: Separate E/direct-mode control: the 96-SM full-request pipeline regresses median throughput versus direct whole_graph132. Long tails occur without hybrid FFN activation forwarding, but mode changes also alter wire volume/QPs/reduction. Never substitute this cohort for primary hybrid results.

Nsight_B_132_SM.scope: Separate short B/132-SM profiles; not throughput samples. GIN kernel intervals include completion waits. Positive-row reply/GEMM overlap is strict; PackRows overlap without saved expert counts remains a candidate interval only.

Nsight_C_96_SM.scope: Separate profiled cohorts and source hashes; never throughput samples. Reply intervals include GIN completion waits and are not wire-only overlap.

Profile_budget_comparison.scope: Separate profiled cohorts and source hashes; never throughput samples. Reply intervals include GIN completion waits and are not wire-only overlap.

Nsight_E.scope: Separate E-source profiles; GIN spans include waits, not wire-only time.

publication.scope: Public evidence bundle; unpublished raw traces, logs, analysis scripts and auxiliary figures retain source names and original hashes as provenance.
